verdict.rationale: Smithery is a hosted MCP connection and registry service, so data export and portability is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence documents any export of account data, connections, credentials or metadata in open formats. The shutdown notice says accounts and API keys stopped working but describes no export path, and credential storage is documented as write-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
